sections.title: Meet *Bill*

image.alt: Bill Cunningham, arms crossed, in a Bill Cunningham Fitness shirt

body: With over 16 years in the health and fitness industry, Bill combines deep technical expertise with an approachable, motivating style. His philosophy is simple: help people feel better so they can do more in life.

Bill is certified by the National Federation of Personal Trainers and as a Functional Movement Specialist through Gray Cook’s Functional Movement Systems. Nutrition coach Vanessa Stone holds multiple certifications from Precision Nutrition and the National Academy of Sports Medicine.
list: Board member, Aiken Chamber of Commerce

items.text: I started working out with Bill Cunningham Fitness when I was 52. After a very short time, I can honestly say that I am in better shape than I have been since high school.
I have been working out with Bill Cunningham Fitness for three years. I’m stronger than I’ve ever been in my life!
They are always encouraging you to get better, but never push you to injury or to adopt unsustainable habits.

sections.title: Not the *“other” gym*

image.alt: The training floor, with members working out under bright yellow walls

body: Expert attention in a fun community atmosphere. Strength, mobility, power and cardio training, with coaches who watch every movement so you do it right and get the most out of it.
list: Plans that progress as you do

items.q: I’m out of shape. Is that OK?
items.a: Absolutely. Every plan starts with a conversation and a movement assessment, and builds from where you are.
